blocks.html: The relevant details to upload a file through a stream.

types.name: writeStream
types.description: A [PassThrough](https://nodejs.org/api/stream.html#class-streampassthrough) write stream object to be used to write the file.

types.name: promise
types.description: A promise that should resolved when the writing process is done to finish the upload.

types.name: url
types.description: The URL of the file once it’s uploaded.

types.name: fileKey
types.description: The identifier of the file in the storage. For example, for a local file service, this can be the file's name.
